title: Fourth meeting with Noe

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Good, you’re here. Did you find the ingredients for my cocktails?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good, you’re here. Did you find the ingredients for my cocktails?

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: It's one final party. One glorious all-night extravaganza, and then I’ll go and get myself re-set. Wipe away all the sadness and start again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's one final party. One glorious all-night extravaganza, and then I’ll go and get myself re-set. Wipe away all the sadness and start again.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Yes, but what’s the point when there’s only me to remember? If I can’t live in the past, I might call it a night.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, but what’s the point when there’s only me to remember? If I can’t live in the past, I might call it a night.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: That’s sweet of you. But even a bon vivant needs Lims. There’s only so many pairs of Derclouds I can sell.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That’s sweet of you. But even a bon vivant needs Lims. There’s only so many pairs of Derclouds I can sell.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Thank you for reviving my recipes, darling. Have one on me, won't you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you for reviving my recipes, darling. Have one on me, won't you?
I don’t do charity, darling.
Listening...

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: A consultant. I could do that. But I'd charge a fee... say, 1000 Lims?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A consultant. I could do that. But I'd charge a fee... say, 1000 Lims?

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Well… you already have two of my cocktails on the menu. It would be a shame to leave the poor things without their friends. Oh, to the wastes with it, I accept!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well… you already have two of my cocktails on the menu. It would be a shame to leave the poor things without their friends. Oh, to the wastes with it, I accept!
I cannot wait darling.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: I didn't know we were doing insults. 800.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn't know we were doing insults. 800.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: Then "no" is my final answer. I think I'll move on after all. This conversation is drab.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then "no" is my final answer. I think I'll move on after all. This conversation is drab.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: You'll make a fine bar owner, I just know it. And as for me... I've finally decided what to do with myself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll make a fine bar owner, I just know it. And as for me... I've finally decided what to do with myself.
Rude. But honest I suppose.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: I'm tired, and I've been a drag - pun intended - on the corps long enough. My second life will be easier for both of us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm tired, and I've been a drag - pun intended - on the corps long enough. My second life will be easier for both of us.

nodes.speaker: Lily Nightingale
nodes.text: And it is not as if I am swimming in a sea of interesting and dignified job offers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And it is not as if I am swimming in a sea of interesting and dignified job offers.
What's that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But what about all of the good memories? Won’t you lose those too?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But what about all of the good memories? Won’t you lose those too?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But what about all of the good memories? Won’t you lose those too?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But what about all of the good memories? Won’t you lose those too?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you should stay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess you know what’s best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess you know what’s best.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I guess you know what’s best.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I guess you know what’s best.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if I had a bar in need of a cocktail consultant…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if I had a bar in need of a cocktail consultant…
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What if I had a bar in need of a cocktail consultant…
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What if I had a bar in need of a cocktail consultant…

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I’m not offering it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Work for me as a cocktail consultant. It sounds as if you can help me make things a success.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Work for me as a cocktail consultant. It sounds as if you can help me make things a success.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Work for me as a cocktail consultant. It sounds as if you can help me make things a success.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Work for me as a cocktail consultant. It sounds as if you can help me make things a success.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Done.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I look forward to doing business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I look forward to doing business.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I look forward to doing business.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I look forward to doing business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Done.
500 is my final offer.
Sure did.
Here you go.
I don't need to know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll make a fine, decent waiter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure you'll make a fine, decent waiter.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sure you'll make a fine, decent waiter.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sure you'll make a fine, decent waiter.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: More than one.
I’m offering a business proposition.
I will.
